title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
description: The timeless tale of Ebenezer Scrooge and the three spirits who change his heart on Christmas Eve.

paragraphs.text: Marley was dead, to begin with. There is no doubt whatever about that. Old Marley was as dead as a door-nail.
Scrooge knew he was dead? Of course he did. Scrooge and he were partners for I don't know how many years. Scrooge was his sole executor, his sole friend, and sole mourner.
Oh! But he was a tight-fisted hand at the grindstone, Scrooge! A squeezing, wrenching, grasping, scraping, clutching, covetous old sinner!
External heat and cold had little influence on Scrooge. No warmth could warm, no wintry weather chill him. No wind that blew was bitterer than he.

chapters.title: The First of the Three Spirits

paragraphs.text: When Scrooge awoke, it was so dark that he could scarcely distinguish the transparent window from the walls of his chamber. The chimes of a neighbouring church struck the four quarters.
The curtains of his bed were drawn aside by a strange figure—like a child, yet not so like a child as like an old man. Its hair was white as if with age, yet the face had not a wrinkle in it.
'I am the Ghost of Christmas Past,' said the Spirit. 'Your past. Rise, and walk with me!'
